description: This source file is an assembly code for a MIPS-based bootloader responsible for loading an LZMA compressed kernel for Atheros AR7XXX/AR9XXX boards. It includes startup routines such as relocation, cache flushing, BSS initialization, and jumping to the decompression routine.

methods.name: ehb
methods.description: A macro for the MIPS 'ehb' (Execution Hint Barrier) instruction, ensuring ordering of instructions.
